title: Byrna Technologies Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-08
summary: Byrna Technologies Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 8, 2026, disclosing that board member Emily Rooney informed the company on April 3, 2026, of her decision not to stand for re-election at the 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. Rooney had served on the board since October 1, 2021. The filing states her decision was not the result of any disagreement with the company.
key_points: Emily Rooney notified the company on April 3, 2026, of her decision not to stand for re-election
Rooney served on the board since October 1, 2021
She held positions as Chair of the Product Safety Committee and member of the Nominating and Governance Committee and Ad Hoc Search and Succession Committee
The filing explicitly states no disagreement with the company on operations, policies, or practices
The filing was signed by CFO Laurilee Kearnes on April 8, 2026
